name: Evolve

seo.title: Ecoventura Evolve: Galapagos Yacht Cruise
seo.description: Ecoventura's Evolve: a 20-guest Relais & Chateaux expedition yacht, 10 staterooms, 7-night Galapagos loops from San Cristobal. 2026 and 2027 dates and rates.

tagline: Twenty guests, ten staterooms and two naturalist guides on a 7-night Galapagos loop.
answer: Evolve is one of Ecoventura's three identical 43-metre expedition yachts, launched in 2023. She carries 20 guests in 10 staterooms on one deck, with 13 crew including two naturalist guides. She sails two 7-night loops from San Cristobal, Beaches and Bays (A) and Volcanic Wonders (B), every Sunday. She suits couples, families and first-timers who want a small boat with an open bar.
facts: 10 on the main deck; two pairs connect into Premium Suites
13, including 2 naturalist guides and a concierge
7-night A (Beaches and Bays) or B (Volcanic Wonders), Sunday to Sunday from San Cristobal; 14 nights back to back
Relais & Chateaux member (Ecoventura's three yachts are the only Relais & Chateaux expedition yachts in the Galapagos, per Ecoventura)
overview: Evolve is one of three identical expedition yachts that Ecoventura, a Galapagos operator for more than 35 years, built for the islands. She was launched in 2023; her sisters are Origin and Theory. Ecoventura says the hull design cuts the time spent between islands, which leaves more time ashore.

All ten staterooms are on the main deck, each 145 sq ft with panoramic windows, twin beds that convert to a king and a walk-in rainfall shower. A pullman berth makes a triple, and two pairs of staterooms connect into 300 sq ft Premium Suites with a living room and two bathrooms. On board there is a dining room, lounge, library, indoor bar, gym and a sundeck with a four-person jacuzzi, day beds and a wet bar.

She sails two 7-night loops from San Cristobal, alternating every Sunday. Beaches and Bays (A) covers Espanola, Floreana, Santa Cruz, Bartolome and North Seymour, with waved albatross on Espanola from April to December. Volcanic Wonders (B) goes north to Genovesa and west to Isabela and Fernandina for flightless cormorants. Ecoventura says booking both gives 14 nights without repeating a visitor site.
why: Two naturalist guides for 20 guests, which Ecoventura calls the lowest ratio in the Galapagos, and an open bar that covers wine, beer and cocktails. Wi-Fi is Starlink and included.
The newest of the three, launched in 2023. Evolve guests visit the Cerro Colorado tortoise breeding centre on day one of Itinerary A, and on B she takes Punta Espinoza and Elizabeth Bay.

itineraries.name: Itinerary A: Beaches and Bays, 7 nights
itineraries.direction: San Cristobal round trip, Sunday to Sunday (Southern and Central route)

days.title: Puerto Baquerizo Moreno and Leon Dormido
days.summary: Fly into San Cristobal, transfer by bus and Zodiac to the yacht for lunch and a safety briefing. Sail to Leon Dormido (Kicker Rock) for blue-footed boobies, frigatebirds and sunset. Evolve guests also visit La Galapaguera de Cerro Colorado, the tortoise breeding centre.

days.title: Cerro Brujo and Punta Pitt
days.summary: Zodiac to the coral sand beach at Cerro Brujo and a first snorkel with sea lions. Afternoon hike at Punta Pitt, where blue-footed, red-footed and Nazca boobies nest close together.

days.title: Punta Suarez and Gardner Bay
days.summary: Punta Suarez for waved albatross (courting April to December), marine iguanas, Nazca boobies and the blowhole. Afternoon snorkel at Gardner Islet and the white beach at Gardner Bay.

days.title: Punta Cormorant, Devil's Crown and Post Office Bay
days.summary: Olive-green beach and flamingo lagoon at Punta Cormorant, then snorkelling at Devil's Crown or Champion Islet. Afternoon at the barrel post office in Post Office Bay.

days.title: Highlands and Charles Darwin Station
days.summary: Los Gemelos craters and giant tortoises at Rancho Primicias or El Chato. Afternoon at the Fausto Llerena breeding centre and the Charles Darwin Research Station in Puerto Ayora.

days.title: Bartolome and Black Turtle Cove
days.summary: Choose the 400-step climb to the Pinnacle Rock viewpoint or a Zodiac ride for penguins, then snorkel. Afternoon Zodiac ride in Black Turtle Cove, looking for sea turtles and golden rays.

days.title: South Plaza and North Seymour
days.summary: Land iguanas, sea lions and prickly pear cactus on South Plaza. Afternoon frigatebird colony and a last deep-water snorkel at North Seymour.

days.title: Interpretation Center and fly out
days.summary: Disembark after breakfast, visit the Interpretation Center on San Cristobal and transfer to the airport.

itineraries.name: Itinerary B: Volcanic Wonders, 7 nights
itineraries.direction: San Cristobal round trip, Sunday to Sunday (Western and Northern route)

days.title: Puerto Baquerizo Moreno and Leon Dormido
days.summary: Fly into San Cristobal, transfer by bus and Zodiac to the yacht for lunch and a safety briefing. Sail to Leon Dormido (Kicker Rock) for blue-footed boobies, frigatebirds and sunset.

days.title: Prince Philip's Steps and Darwin Bay
days.summary: Red-footed and Nazca boobies and storm petrels at Prince Philip's Steps, with kayaking or a deep-water snorkel. Afternoon on the coral beach at Darwin Bay among great frigatebirds.

days.title: Las Bachas and Cerro Dragon
days.summary: Flamingo lagoons and a long white beach at Las Bachas, with a swim or snorkel. Afternoon at Cerro Dragon for land iguanas and flamingos.

days.title: Punta Espinoza and Urbina Bay
days.summary: Hike and snorkel at Punta Espinoza on Fernandina among marine iguanas. Sail the Bolivar Channel, then walk the uplifted seabed at Urbina Bay among land iguanas and giant tortoises.

days.title: Elizabeth Bay and Tagus Cove
days.summary: Panga ride through the mangroves of Elizabeth Bay for penguins, rays, sea lions and turtles. Afternoon hike or kayak at Tagus Cove.

days.title: Puerto Egas
days.summary: Shoreline walk at Puerto Egas on Santiago for tide pools, herons and marine iguanas, then a snorkel from the beach.

days.title: Highlands and Charles Darwin Station
days.summary: Los Gemelos craters and giant tortoises at Rancho Primicias or El Chato. Afternoon at the Charles Darwin Research Station in Puerto Ayora.

days.title: Interpretation Center and fly out
days.summary: Disembark after breakfast, visit the Interpretation Center on San Cristobal and transfer to the airport.

faqs: How much does an Ecoventura Evolve cruise cost?

For 2027 Ecoventura publishes US$11,500 per person for a 7-night cruise in a Deluxe Stateroom, two sharing, US$21,000 single and US$23,000 per person in a Premium Suite. Festive weeks add US$500. Flights, the US$200 park fee and the US$20 transit card are extra.
What is the difference between Itinerary A and B?

A, Beaches and Bays, covers the older southern and central islands: San Cristobal, Espanola, Floreana, Santa Cruz, Bartolome and North Seymour, with waved albatross on Espanola. B, Volcanic Wonders, goes to Genovesa in the north and the young western islands of Isabela and Fernandina, home of the flightless cormorant. Both run 7 nights from San Cristobal.
Are Origin, Theory and Evolve different?
No. Ecoventura says the three yachts are identical in design and layout, launched in 2016, 2019 and 2023. A few visitor sites differ by yacht on some days.
How many guests are on the Evolve?
Twenty, in ten staterooms, with 13 crew: a captain, a concierge, two naturalist guides and the rest of the team.
What is included on an Ecoventura cruise?

Meals, an open bar with wine, beer and cocktails, Starlink Wi-Fi, laundry on weekdays, twice-daily guided excursions, kayaks, paddleboards, snorkel gear and wetsuits, and Galapagos airport transfers. Flights, the park fee, the transit card and gratuities are not included.
How do I get to the yacht?
Fly to Quito or Guayaquil at least a day early, then take Avianca AV1630 to San Cristobal on Sunday. Ecoventura books the flight and meets you at the airport.

suits.line: Ten staterooms, an open bar and a jacuzzi on the sundeck.
One 7-night loop covers the classic southern islands or the volcanic west.
